authority: Workflows controls workflow semantics; Codex controls runtime execution mechanics
rules: Never implement a CX node from an invented Workflows API.
CX-001 must record exact main/base SHAs and classify every required contract IMPLEMENTED, SPECIFIED_ONLY, PARTIAL, UNKNOWN, or BLOCKED.
Codex may cache Workflows metadata for latency but cached state is never authoritative.
Codex must not own WorkflowVersion, WorkflowInstance, legal workflow transitions, or product execution scheduling.
A cross-repository gate passes only when both repositories provide exact-head evidence for the relevant contract and implementation.
